title: Sky Demo / Rockets and continuous blast physics
goal: Select weapon 6 and fire two rockets at crates or terrain. Watch crates move through both explosions while craters update. F8 records diagnostics.
changes: Rocket Launcher added: two rockets per reload, impact explosions, blast damage, crate impulses and 3 m craters. Crates and actors now keep moving during terrain edits; missing streamed terrain still suspends them safely. The prepared grenade terrain and sky controls remain available.
controls: 6 selects Rocket Launcher; Q or controller Triangle cycles weapons. LMB / R2 fires; R / Square reloads. B / L1 throws grenades. F8 records diagnostics. Ctrl+F3 opens sky controls; Ctrl+F9 toggles upper clouds; Ctrl+F12 cycles sky presets. Rocket Launcher model by irons3th, CC-BY-4.0; source and full credit in assets/rocket_launcher/license.txt.
